column1: # Rows the repository settles for games that still pack from a provisional profile (switchpad/make_provisional.py: a guess, no
# profile folder of their own). nxn_pack.py writes them into the provisional game.tsv before anything reads it, on every pack
# (apply_provisional_overrides). A game with a real profile in dm/games is never touched.
# Format: title ID <TAB> game.tsv key <TAB> value. Say why above each game's rows (the log line, the code that needs it).
# Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics. No system resource, so nninitStartup (main+0x7c8b88) sets a heap of the pool − used
# memory and opens nn::mem::StandardAllocator on it (up to 0xC7500000 − used). With the provisional 1 GB pool the allocator ran
# dry while the game set up its archives' decoders: malloc(0xd0) (main+0xb937c0) returned 0 and main+0xb93ae0 read 0x8
# (SIGSEGV right after the save mounted, iPad log 2026-11-18). The whole pool of a 4 GB Switch, as upstream profiles report.
# Rabbids Party of Legends. The game's own page allocator (first malloc: main+0x734ac → main+0x2583ac) reserves a 12 GB address
# region with nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion(0x300000000) and does not check the result: in the provisional alias region (4.375 GB
# + 2 GB grown, less the SDK's ~1 GB node area) it got 0, committed pages at 0 + 0x200000000 and wrote there (SIGBUS
# addr=0x20000ffff at main+0x258ad4 in main's init_array, iPad log 2026-11-18). A 16 GB alias region holds the node area, that
# region and the small one before it; address space only, nothing is mapped until the game maps it. mem_reserve = alias + the
# 256 MB in front + the 1 GB stack region + the 128 MB heap region (0x170000000 − 0x118000000 before).
# Its pool too: with the region fixed (art61) the game got to its intro movie at the provisional 1 GB pool, 0.82 GB of it used, and the
# movie's track object read back as garbage (SIGSEGV addr=0x2b at subsdk1+0x2e9e2c, NuMediaExtractor::fetchTrackSamples, on the audio
# read thread, iPad log 2026-11-21). The whole pool of a 4 GB Switch, as Clubhouse Games 51's.
# Pummel Party 1.14.1i. The iPad aborts after the first frame in CreateThread (main+0xadd3e4):
# the SDK's MapAliasStack aborts before MapMemory, with a 0x800000-byte stack and a 256 MB region.
# Give the SDK a 1 GB stack region and grow the reservation by the same amount to preserve the heap.
# It Takes Two. Unreal Engine 4.26: its engine region is cut from 62 GB to 4064 MB and its FMallocBinned3 replaced by the host's
# allocator (dm/games/010092A0172E4000/patches.py, hle_uemalloc.c), so it no longer needs the 64 GB alias region the guess gave
# it (the iPad held 49 GB of it and the game hung in main's init_array, iPad log 2026-11-20). Pikmin 4's 5 GB block.
# The 1.0.3 build can request 60 FPS through its Unreal frame limits (hle_fpslock.c); the host gates the writes by build ID.
# Overcooked (0100F28011892000, Unity 2019.4). The provisional 1 GB pool ran out soon after the first picture: Unity's
# MemoryManager::Reallocate (main+0x51fc90) got 0 for 320 bytes from a dynamic_array's growth (main+0x2a9130) and copied into it
# (SIGSEGV addr=0 in the SDK's memcpy, pool 0.75 of 1.00 GB used, iPad log 2026-11-21). The whole pool of a 4 GB Switch.
